Committee: Education Policy
Sponsor: Collins
Analyst: Daniel Davenport
Date: 02/22/2021
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 407 as introduced could increase the administrative obligations of the State Department of Education by an undetermined amount to develop a State Seal of Biliteracy program for high school students demonstrating proficiency in English and at least one other language. This bill could also increase the administrative obligations of school systems that elect to participate in this program by an undetermined amount to: (1) maintain records to identify students earning the State Seal of Biliteracy, and (2) affix the insignia on the diploma and transcripts of each student that earns the State Seal of Biliteracy.
In addition, this bill provides that it is Legislatures intent that no fee be charged to a student for this program.
Terri Collins, Chair
Education Policy
